node.title: Re: Why $FIle::Find::prune = 1 returns used only once error
node.author: jcb
node.doctext:
First, complain about the mispackaging of Perl by your distribution. Omitting core modules like that is a bug in the distribution.

Second, [doc://use] Module is equivalent to BEGIN { require Module; Module->import; }; note the lack of arguments to the import method. If asked for default imports, [module://File::Find] apparently does some magic to make $File::Find::prune known that is not done if you explicitly import only the find procedure.
